_about: CyberSweeper palette tokens. Source of truth for every color in the game, the mockups and the download page. Unlock thresholds are placeholders until the bot simulations (milestone 2) set real numbers.

roles.void: Background behind and beyond the board; the infinite dark the board fades into
roles.grid: Hairlines between revealed cells, panel dividers
roles.tileEdge: 1px top/left bevel highlight on hidden cells, panel borders
roles.cipher: Faint hex-byte glyph drawn on hidden cells
roles.accent: Primary neon: focus, signal meter, selected states, minimap explored area
roles.accent2: Secondary neon: chromatic-aberration partner, highlights, unlock moments
roles.danger: Mine hits, critical signal, lost links
roles.n1-n8: Number colors for revealed cells 1 through 8

palettes.name: Signal
palettes.vibe: The house look. Cyan and magenta on blue-black.

palettes.name: Hotwire
palettes.vibe: Hot pink lead, cyan support, plum shadows.

palettes.name: Root access
palettes.vibe: Phosphor terminal. Greens for low numbers, heating to amber and red as danger rises.

palettes.name: Rustbelt
palettes.vibe: Sodium streetlight amber, oxidized teal, burnt-orange hazards.

palettes.name: Icebreaker
palettes.vibe: Chrome, gunmetal and frost. The trophy palette.

palettes.name: Plaintext
palettes.vibe: Built for color vision deficiency. Numbers 1-4 stay distinct under protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia, and hidden vs revealed cells differ by brightness, not hue. Always unlocked.

display.use: Wordmark, headings, menu items, UI words, buttons

data.use: Cell numbers, score, timers, coordinates, any digits

type.files: design/fonts (woff2 for web, ttf for Godot). Both SIL OFL 1.1, bundle the license files with the game.
type.cell_number: Martian Mono 800 at 52% of cell size; never below 11px on screen

shape.chamfer: One cut corner is the structural motif. Hidden cells: top-left cut at 16% of cell size. Panels and buttons: top-left and bottom-right cut, 10px.

effects.scanlines: Horizontal 1px lines every 3px, ink at 3.5% opacity, whole screen, toggle in settings
effects.vignette: Radial, void color, 0% at 55% radius to 85% at corners. Sells the board fading into an infinite void.
effects.glow: Numbers and accents: 0 0 6px at 70% + 0 0 18px at 35% of their own color
effects.chromatic_aberration: accent2 offset -2px x, accent offset +2px x, used on the wordmark always and on mine hits for 400ms
effects.cipher_glyph: Each hidden cell shows a 2-char hex byte in cipher color. Bytes re-roll in a slow diagonal wave (about 1 cell per 80ms). On reveal, the byte scrambles for 120ms then resolves into the number.
